items.title: Catalog 1.1.0: crawled WinGet metadata and sourced records
items.description: Apps now carry versions, hash-pinned installer URLs and compatibility facts taken from microsoft/winget-pkgs, with per-field sources. Records that have no WinGet package show their official download, page or unavailable status.

items.title: Polite crawler, search index and API documentation
items.description: A robots-aware crawler proposes catalog changes for review, the build generates a search index, and the developer pages document the schemas and endpoints.

items.title: Driver source finder and vendor directory
items.description: A searchable index of official driver sources (Intel, Realtek, FTDI, Silicon Labs, WCH and OEM portals) with evidence, hashes where publishers print them, and clearly labelled third-party leads.

items.title: WinGet script generator with Ninite-style quick pick
items.description: Pick apps, review the install plan and download a PowerShell script that checks Windows and WinGet, asks you to type YES and reports failures. Nothing is installed from the browser.
